content: साहित्यम् .²1 Association, fellowship, combination, society. .²2 Literary or rhetorical composition; साहित्यसंगीतकलाविहीनः साक्षात् पशुः पुच्छविषाणहीनः <ls>Bh. 2. 12</ls>. .²3 The science of rhetoric, art of poetry; साहित्यपाथोनिधिमन्थनोत्थं कर्णामृतं रक्षत हे कवीन्द्राः <ls>Vikr. 1. 11</ls>; साहित्यदर्पणम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 A collection of materials for the production or performance of anything (a doubtful sense). .²5 Agreement, harmony.
